$comment: Human decisions on findings that required judgment. Keyed by file + component + WCAG criterion — never by line number, which drifts on the first refactor. reason and approvedBy are mandatory.

exceptions.reason: Focus trap is intentional — the ARIA dialog pattern requires it. Escape handler and focus restore are both implemented.
Drag is present but not the only path — onMoveUp/onMoveDown buttons and arrow-key handling provide the single-pointer alternative.
